newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel barges tight, cargoes languish.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel barges tight, cargoes languish.

text.p: Tight supply supported NWE jet fuel barge premiums on Thursday but cargoes were under pressure from feeble demand, traders said.
Benchmark Jan IPE futures fell 75 cents to $218.50 a tonne, in thin trade with little fundamental news to give direction.
Cargoes were assessed at Jan IPE +28, under pressure from sketchy buying interest and ample offers. Barges were stable at Jan IPE +$25, supported by inquiries from two majors and a lack of offers.
In the Med the arbitrage to Asia continued to be discussed but players were cautious about arranging deals with the market in backwardation.
